senses.gloss: f. (preced. wds.; sub. תִּסְפֹּרֶת) Lulian style of hair-cutting, clipped hair.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 51a:7">Ned. 51ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>כסום יכסמו</he> <cite ref="Ezekiel 44:20">Ez. XLIV, 20</cite>) <he>כעין ל׳</he> like the L. style, expl. <he>ת׳ יחידאה</he> ‘the style of a distinguished person’, <he>ראשו של זה וכ׳</he> the top of one (row of hair) touching the root of the other; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 22b:21">Snh. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>כמין תספרת ל׳</he>.
